sections.advice: Bellinzona → Lugano is 27 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Lugano → Andermatt is 94 km of getting across. Ride it tidily and keep the enthusiasm for what comes after.
Andermatt → Furka Pass climbs about 2429 m in 18 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Furka Pass → Tasch for Zermatt drops about 2429 m over 94 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.

scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: For 30 km this is Grand Tour of Switzerland, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Furka Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it. The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 2429 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Simplon Pass Road
scenicChapters.narrative: 102 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it — this is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.

grand-tour-of-switzerland-bellinzona-tas.story: 253 km one way from Bellinzona - plan on about 4 h 06 of riding. The stops in between: Lugano, Andermatt and Furka Pass. The highest point is about 2,650 m. Furka Pass is subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.

legend-sicily-madonie-mountain-road.slogan: Sicily Madonie Mountain Road – a named road, mapped from its own anchor points
legend-sicily-madonie-mountain-road.story: curated scenic road. mountains, stone villages, Mediterranean views. A one-way ride of 36 km, Cefalù to Petralia Soprana - roughly 39 min in the saddle. The highest point is about 1,550 m. The line favours views over speed.

scenicChapters.title: Sicily Madonie Mountain Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 9 km this is Sicily Madonie Mountain Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.
